messages:
omar (AE): Quick sync — need to lock POC acceptance for FinServ pilot. Customer expects 2-week POC. High-level asks: latency, cost, and quality thresholds. Can we agree targets?

maria (SE): Proposed targets: p95 latency <= 350ms for 512-token requests on Dedicated; token cost target ~ $0.40 / 1k tokens after caching & batching; quality: 90% pass rate on our eval set (semantic-similarity >= 0.85) and no regressions vs baseline.

omar (AE): Customer will accept 95th percentile SLA? They asked for 300ms p95.

sachin (Solutions Eng): 300ms p95 is tight on hosted for worst-case 1k tokens. For 512 tokens on Dedicated with small-batch and KV cache, 300ms is doable. We should add a fallback policy: if p95 > 300ms for 1h => switch to larger instance/quantized model. :warning:

lisa (Security PM): Security gating: customer needs KMS integration, audit logs, and data retention policy. For POC we can use hosted with encrypted logs, retention set to 30d. On-prem is out of scope for 2-week POC.

omar (AE): Pricing/credits question: how many free tokens to cover eval? Customer plans ~3M tokens across eval and smoke tests.

maria (SE): Estimate: with caching/kv we'll see effective tokens ~2.2M. Cost estimate at $0.40/1k -> ~$880. Recommend offering $1k trial credit and a committed 1-month Dedicated trial if they want predictable throughput.

sachin (Solutions Eng): Run this quick eval script on their dataset:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-v1","prompt":"<PROMPT>","max_tokens":512}' | jq .
```

sachin (Solutions Eng): For automated eval use this config (run locally):

```json
{\"dataset\":\"s3://customer-evals/intent-2000.json\",\"metric\":\"cosine_sim\",\"threshold\":0.85}
```

omar (AE): Acceptance criteria to propose to customer:
- p95 latency <= 350ms (preferred 300ms) for 512-token requests
- Avg inference cost <= $0.50 / 1k tokens (target $0.40)
- Eval pass rate >= 90% (cosine >= 0.85)
- No data exfil concerns: KMS + 30d logs
- POC length: 14 days; deliverables: latency report, cost breakdown, eval pass/fail

sachin (Solutions Eng): I'll own test harness and load profile. Can we get staging dataset by EOD Thu?

omar (AE): I'll confirm with customer. If staging delayed, we push POC start by 3 days. :slightly_smiling_face:

lisa (Security PM): Also adding: need sign-off on DPA & IP clause before ingesting any customer data.

omar (AE): Noted. Thanks all — will update thread after customer call tomorrow. :thumbsup:
